senses.gloss: m. (an affected pronunciation of <cite ref="A03448"><he>אֶתְרוֹגָא</he></cite>; v. <cite ref="V00964"><he>תְּרוּנְגָּא</he></cite>; Pers. turundj) = <cite ref="A03448"><he>אֶתְרוֹגָא</he></cite>.
units: Kidd. 70ᵃ כל האומר א׳ וכ׳ whoever says Ethrunga betrays a third (goodly) portion of haughtiness; either say Ethrog (hebr.) as the Rabbis do, or Ethroga (ch.) as the people do. Cmp. גּוּנְדְּרִיתָא.
